potential: Round-5 force-only development MTP; energies/virials uncalibrated
same_atom_set: initial Newton-layer Ag atoms in the central TTM source core
q6_definition: Ag-only Steinhardt q6, cutoff 4.0 A, per-atom time average within each rolling window
ptm_definition: FCC code 1; non-FCC fraction per Ag over the same 21 snapshots
msd_definition: unwrapped XY-periodic per-atom squared net displacement; Newton-layer drift removed at each 0.05 ps increment

thresholds.joint_rule: per-Ag atom: mean q6 over the 1 ps window below cutoff AND PTM non-FCC in at least 80% of structural snapshots AND drift-corrected per-atom MSD_i = |unwrapped displacement over 1 ps|^2 above threshold

reference_conditions.solid: 864-atom pure Ag, round5 MTP, FCC/NVT target 300 K for 2 ps
reference_conditions.dense_mobile: 864-atom pure Ag, round5 MTP, heated to 2600 K under NPT, rescaled to L=26.761 A, then NVT at 2600 K for 2 ps

limitations: Development MTP was fitted to forces only; energies and virials are uncalibrated, and the dense reference pressure is therefore not a physical pressure prediction.
Thresholds are model-specific exploratory structural thresholds, not a measured Ag melting point; they do not transfer to EAM/Morse.
Pure-Ag references do not validate Ag/Ti3SiC2 interfacial forces or the composite thermal response.

caveats: Classifier is calibrated only against the same development MTP pure-Ag references and remains exploratory.
Large forces and uncalibrated MTP energy/virial prevent quantitative physical melt-pool claims.
Clusters use 3.5 A Ag-Ag connectivity, periodic x/y, open z; convex hull is a geometric envelope.
